The user specifically says "check the door locks and ensure they're secured if any are unlocked". So we need to call displayCarStatus with option "doors" to see status. Then if any are unlocked, we need to lock them. The lockDoors function requires unlock boolean (True if unlocking, False otherwise) and door array. To lock, we set unlock=false and specify doors. But we don't know which doors are unlocked. We could just lock all doors. That would lock any unlocked ones. So we can call lockDoors with unlock:false and door:["driver","passenger","rear_left","rear_right"]. That will lock all doors.

We should do it in order: first display status, then lock. Let's do that.
